summary.objective_summary: DRY RUN, not a completed pipeline. By design (--dry-run), Implementation and Verification were never attempted -- the Engineer and Quality Engineer were never dispatched, and no file under demo-repo/ was modified. Unlike the prior rehearsal run-20260803-riskband-001 (which blocked in Research on a fenced Architect response), this run's Research phase completed cleanly: a real, live-dispatched Architect (agent id a8aeef2bdc4451dc6) returned raw, unfenced JSON on the first attempt, which validated and promoted to a canonical findings.json (5 findings: 4 found, 1 honest not_found, citing that no reference to overall_band/risk_profile exists yet in the three in-scope files; 2 open_questions correctly deferring the out-of-scope attribute chain and all implementation work). Discovery also completed cleanly: scope.json was independently grounded by reading explanations.py, cli.py, pipeline.py, risk_profile.py, risk_bands.py, and test_explanations.py, then validated and promoted. A standalone test-runner Skill smoke check (command_id C-1, python -m pytest tests/unit/test_explanations.py -q against demo-repo) succeeded: real command_result, exit_code 0, 3 passed, no mutation detected, genuinely invoked via the Skill tool (not a direct wrapper call), and its request/result identity fields matched exactly. git status --short -- demo-repo was independently confirmed empty after the run.
remaining_risks: Engineer/Quality Engineer staged continuation (Agent start -> SendMessage resume) remains fully unexercised live -- this dry run only exercised a single-shot Architect dispatch and one standalone test-runner Skill call, not the staged multi-turn protocol.
